map.& < > \" ' 在对应上下文需转义，防止解析错乱与 XSS。: & < > " ' must be escaped in the relevant context to prevent parsing errors and XSS.
map.每个实体如 &amp; 占 5 字符，原文 1 字符，故含大量特殊字符时体积成倍: Each entity like & is 5 chars vs 1 original char, so volume multiplies when many special chars are present.
map.HTML 实体用于页面文本安全显示，URL 编码用于传输，两者场景不同。: HTML entities display text safely on the page; URL encoding is for transmission. The two scenarios differ.
